T0569.title: Knowledge-Base Permission
T0569.definition: Access rules that determine which users, roles, or tenants can retrieve specific knowledge-base content.
T0569.description: Knowledge-base permissions decide which documents, chunks, and metadata a user or model may retrieve. If permissions are too coarse or fail to inherit source-system ACLs, RAG can leak internal documents or cross-tenant content. Controls focus on document-level ACLs, pre-retrieval filtering, synchronization consistency, and unauthorized-recall testing.
T0569.usageExample: Assess Knowledge-Base Permission related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
